messages:
Maya Patel: Quick PRD sync 1 need final acceptance bullets for chat/completions, embeddings, and rerank before roadmap lock. See draft: https://redwood.internal/specs/unified-api-prd.
Liam Chen: Can we get explicit SLO numbers for the GA traffic mix? QA needs targets for perf replay.
Anika Gomez: Draft targets in doc: chat 95th <= 200ms, embeddings <= 150ms, rerank <= 320ms for hosted GA. Dedicated tighter.
Ravi Singh: Note: rerank tail depends on KV cache hit-rate. We'll need eviction tuning and a pilot pool for any deterministic mode.
Jordan Brooks: SDK changes: add optional `response_profile` and `client_hints.max_latency_ms`. We'll warn when high-cost profiles are used on free-tier.
Sasha Ortiz: Pilots requested per-route cost headers and explicit fallback headers. They'll validate billing using that.
Maya Patel: Acceptance bullets suggestion:
- Additive params only (no breaking changes)
- SLOs met on perf replay for GA slice
- Rerank quality gate: top-1 swap <= 2.5% (nondet); stable mode for pilots <= 1%
- Embedding stability: mean cosine delta < 0.02 after quantization
- Observability: `x-rw-cost-units` and `x-rw-fallback-reason` headers
- Failover: rerank unavailable -> return unranked + fallback header
Liam Chen: QA block: any quantization that causes embedding drift >0.02 on pinned corpora blocks GA. QA owns nightly sweep.
Anika Gomez: Research will run an overnight quantization matrix and post results. If models fail, remove from GA candidate list.
Ravi Singh: Infra tasks: allocate pilot pool, tune KV eviction to favor session affinity, add per-route cost metrics. I'll create tickets.
Jordan Brooks: Rollout: internal -> pilot (stable allowed) -> 5% canary (nondet only) -> GA (nondet default; stable opt-in). Monitor latency, error rate, quality regressions.
Sasha Ortiz: Pilot candidates: Atlas, Meridian, EchoSearch. I'll start outreach after product locks gating.
Maya Patel: Edge cases to document: long contexts -> 413 `context_too_large` + chunking guide; malformed embeddings -> 400 with example; empty chat -> 422 with guidance.
Liam Chen: Also document partial stream cancellation behavior: emit `x-rw-stream-finalized` header and cooldown cache reuse.
Anika Gomez: Add quantization acceptance tests to the spec and a small eval harness for rerank stability.
Maya Patel: Owners: product=Maya, eng=Ravi, SDK=Jordan, QA=Liam, research=Anika, pilots=Sasha. I'll update the PRD and share a trimmed acceptance checklist. Thanks all. :rocket:
